summary: Berto Acquisition Corp. II (SPAC) filed an 8-K reporting the closing of its IPO of 31,510,000 units at $10.00/unit, including 4,110,000 units from full exercise of the underwriters' over-allotment option, generating $315.1M gross proceeds. Each unit consists of one ordinary share and one-third of one warrant exercisable at $11.50. The underwriting agreement with Needham & Company, warrant agreement with Continental Stock Transfer, and insider letter agreement were entered. The proceeds will be held in trust pending a business combination. The units, ordinary shares, and warrants trade on Nasdaq under GUACU, GUAC, and GUACW. Watch for target announcement within 18-24 months; risk-arb centers on trust value vs. unit trading price and potential deal consummation.
